verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a public Lambda Cloud API of REST endpoints for creating and managing cloud resources, including launching and restarting instances, cloud-init, alternative base images, and workspaces. A runtime probe confirmed a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec and a key-gated `/api/v1/instances` endpoint, and a third-party CLI/MCP server that launches and terminates instances shows independent programmatic use. Missing for 10: evidence that the API covers 1-Click Clusters and managed Kubernetes/Slurm, since 1CC reservation is documented only through the console; documented rate limits are also tight (1 req/s general).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
You can also launch instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
You can also restart instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
the instance-provisioning REST API is live and key-gated
